paras.en: Beside the well stood the remains of an old stone wall. When I came back from my work the following evening, I saw my little prince from far away, sitting up there with his legs dangling. And I heard him speaking:
paras.zh: 井旁边有一段残破的旧石墙。第二天傍晚，我从干活的地方回来，远远看见我的小王子坐在墙头上，两条腿垂着。我听见他在说话：

paras.en: “So you don’t remember?” he was saying. “It’s not quite here!”
paras.zh: “你难道不记得了吗？”他说，“不完全是在这里！”

paras.en: Another voice must have answered him, because he replied:
paras.zh: 想必有另一个声音回答了他，因为他回应道：

paras.en: “Yes! Yes! It is the right day, but this isn’t the place…”
paras.zh: “对！对！日子是对的，可地点不是这里……”

paras.en: I kept walking towards the wall. I still couldn’t see or hear anyone. Yet the little prince replied again:
paras.zh: 我继续朝石墙走去。我仍然看不见任何人，也听不见任何人的声音。可是小王子又回答道：

paras.en: “…Of course. You’ll see where my trail begins in the sand. You only have to wait for me there. I’ll be there tonight…”
paras.zh: “……当然。你会看见我在沙地上留下的足迹从哪里开始。你只要在那里等我就行了。今晚我会到那里去……”

paras.en: I was twenty metres from the wall, and I still couldn’t see anything.
paras.zh: 我离石墙二十米，仍然什么也看不见。

paras.en: After a silence, the little prince spoke again:
paras.zh: 沉默了一会儿，小王子又说：

paras.en: “Is your venom good? Are you sure you won’t make me suffer for long?”
paras.zh: “你的毒液管用吗？你确定不会让我痛苦很久吗？”

paras.en: I stopped, my heart tightening, but I still did not understand.
paras.zh: 我停下脚步，心里一紧，却仍然不明白。

paras.en: “Now go away,” he said… “I want to come back down!”
paras.zh: “现在你走吧，”他说……“我要下来了！”

paras.en: Then I too looked down at the foot of the wall, and I jumped! There it was, rearing up towards the little prince: one of those yellow snakes that kill you in thirty seconds. I broke into a run, searching my pocket to pull out my revolver, but at the noise I made, the snake let itself flow gently down into the sand, like a jet of water dying away, and, without much hurry, slipped between the stones with a faint metallic sound.
paras.zh: 于是我也低头朝墙脚看去，猛地一跳！那里有一条黄蛇，正朝小王子竖起身子，就是那种三十秒内就能要人命的蛇。我一边在口袋里摸索着要掏出左轮手枪，一边跑了起来。可蛇听到我的动静，就轻轻地滑落到沙里，像一道渐渐消退的喷泉水柱，又不慌不忙地钻进石头缝中，发出一阵轻微的金属声。

paras.en: I reached the wall just in time to catch my little fellow of a prince in my arms, pale as snow.
paras.zh: 我赶到墙边，正好来得及把我那小小的王子接在怀里，他的脸白得像雪一样。

paras.en: “What’s all this! You’re talking to snakes now!”
paras.zh: “这到底是怎么回事！你现在竟跟蛇说起话来了！”

paras.en: I had undone the golden scarf he always wore. I had wet his temples and made him drink. And now I no longer dared ask him anything. He looked at me gravely and put his arms round my neck. I could feel his heart beating like a bird’s as it dies after being shot with a rifle. He said to me:
paras.zh: 我解开了他那条总不离身的金色围巾，沾湿了他的太阳穴，又给他喝了水。现在，我再也不敢问他什么了。他神情严肃地看着我，伸出双臂搂住我的脖子。我感觉到他的心在跳，就像一只被步枪击中、快要死去的鸟儿的心。他对我说：

paras.en: “I’m glad you found what your machine was missing. You’ll be able to go home…”
paras.zh: “你找到了你的机器缺的东西，我真高兴。你可以回家了……”

paras.en: “How do you know?”
paras.zh: “你怎么知道的？”

paras.en: That was just what I was coming to tell him: against all expectations, I had succeeded in my work!
paras.zh: 我正是来告诉他，我原本已经不抱希望，却竟然把活儿干成了！

paras.en: He gave no answer to my question, but added:
paras.zh: 他没有回答我的问题，只是接着说：

paras.en: “I’m going home today too…”
paras.zh: “今天，我也要回家了……”

paras.en: Then, sadly:
paras.zh: 接着，他忧伤地说：

paras.en: “It’s much further away... it’s much harder...”
paras.zh: “那要远得多……那要难得多……”

paras.en: I could feel clearly that something extraordinary was happening. I held him tight in my arms like a small child, and yet it seemed to me that he was sinking straight down into an abyss, with nothing I could do to hold him back...
paras.zh: 我清楚地感觉到，有件不寻常的事正在发生。我像抱着一个小孩子那样，把他紧紧抱在怀里，却仍觉得他正笔直地沉入深渊，而我无论如何也留不住他……

paras.en: His gaze was serious, lost very far in the distance:
paras.zh: 他的目光很严肃，迷失在很远的地方：

paras.en: “I have your sheep. And I have the box for the sheep. And I have the muzzle...”
paras.zh: “我有你的羊。而且我有装羊的箱子。而且我有嘴套……”

paras.en: And he smiled sadly.
paras.zh: 然后，他忧伤地微笑了。

paras.en: I waited a long time. I could feel him growing warmer little by little:
paras.zh: 我等了很久。我感觉到，他的身体正一点点暖和起来：

paras.en: “Little fellow, you were frightened...”
paras.zh: “小家伙，你刚才害怕了……”

paras.en: Of course he had been frightened! But he laughed softly:
paras.zh: 他当然害怕了！可他轻轻笑着说：

paras.en: “I’ll be much more frightened this evening...”
paras.zh: “今晚我会害怕得多……”

paras.en: Once again I felt chilled by the sense of something that could never be put right. And I realised I could not bear the thought of never hearing that laugh again. To me it was like a fountain in the desert.
paras.zh: 我又一次感到，有些事再也无法挽回，这感觉让我浑身冰冷。而我明白了，光是想到再也听不见那笑声，我就受不了。对我来说，那笑声就像沙漠里的一眼泉。

paras.en: “Little fellow, I want to hear you laugh again...”
paras.zh: “小家伙，我还想听你笑……”

paras.en: But he said to me:
paras.zh: 可是他对我说：

paras.en: “Tonight it will be a year. My star will be right above the place where I fell last year...”
paras.zh: “到了今晚，就满一年了。我的星星会正好在我去年落下的那个地方的上空……”

paras.en: “Little fellow, all this about a snake and a meeting and a star—it’s a bad dream, isn’t it...”
paras.zh: “小家伙，蛇呀，约好的见面呀，星星呀，这些事是一场噩梦，对不对……”

paras.en: But he did not answer my question. He said to me:
paras.zh: 可是他没有回答我的问题。他对我说：

paras.en: “What matters cannot be seen...”
paras.zh: “重要的东西，是看不见的……”

paras.en: “Of course...”
“It’s like the flower. If you love a flower on a star, it is sweet, at night, to look at the sky. All the stars are in bloom.”
paras.zh: “就像那朵花。如果你爱着一朵花，而她在一颗星星上，那么，夜里望着天空，就是一件甜蜜的事。所有的星星都开满了花。”

paras.en: “Of course...”
“It’s like the water. The water you gave me to drink was like music, because of the pulley and the rope... you remember... it tasted good.”
paras.zh: “就像那水一样。你给我喝的水，因为有滑轮和绳子，就像音乐一样……你还记得吧……那水真好喝。”

paras.en: “Of course...”

“At night, you’ll look at the stars. My home is too small for me to show you where my star is. It’s better that way. To you, my star will be one of the stars. So you’ll love looking at all the stars... They’ll all be your friends. And I’m going to give you a present...”
paras.zh: “夜里，你会看星星。我住的地方太小了，没法指给你看我的星星在哪里。这样更好。对你来说，我的星星就是群星中的一颗。那么，所有的星星，你都会喜欢看……它们都会是你的朋友。而且，我还要送你一份礼物……”

paras.en: He laughed again.
paras.zh: 他又笑了。

paras.en: “Ah! Little fellow, little fellow, I love hearing that laugh!”
paras.zh: “啊！小家伙，小家伙，我真喜欢听这笑声！”

paras.en: “That’s just what my present will be... it will be like the water...”
paras.zh: “这正是我要送你的礼物……就像那水一样……”

paras.en: “What do you mean?”
paras.zh: “你是什么意思？”

paras.en: “People don’t all have the same stars. For some, who travel, the stars are guides. For others, they’re nothing but little lights. For others, who are scientists, they’re problems. For my businessman, they were gold. But all those stars stay silent. You’ll have stars like no one else has...”
paras.zh: “人们拥有的星星并不一样。对那些旅行的人来说，星星是向导。对另一些人来说，它们不过是一个个小光点。对那些做学问的人来说，它们是难题。对我说的那个商人来说，它们曾是黄金。可是这些星星全都沉默不语。你呢，你会有别人都没有的星星……”

paras.en: “What do you mean?”
paras.zh: “你是什么意思？”

paras.en: “When you look at the sky at night, because I’ll be living on one of them, because I’ll be laughing on one of them, it will seem to you as though all the stars are laughing. You’ll have stars that know how to laugh, you will!”
paras.zh: “夜里你望着天空的时候，因为我会住在其中一颗星星上，因为我会在其中一颗星星上笑，你就会觉得，好像所有的星星都在笑。你呀，会有会笑的星星！”

paras.en: And he laughed again.
paras.zh: 他又笑了起来。

paras.en: “And when you have found comfort (we always find comfort), you will be glad to have known me. You will always be my friend. You will want to laugh with me. And sometimes you will open your window, just like that, for the pleasure of it... And your friends will be very surprised to see you laughing as you look at the sky. Then you will tell them: ‘Yes, the stars always make me laugh!’ And they will think you are mad. I will have played a very nasty trick on you...”
paras.zh: “等你心里得到安慰的时候（人总会得到安慰的），你会很高兴曾经认识我。你会一直是我的朋友。你会想和我一起笑。有时候，你会打开窗户，就这么打开，只为了开心……你的朋友们看见你望着天空笑，会很惊讶。那时你就对他们说：‘是啊，星星总能让我笑起来！’他们会以为你疯了。那我可就跟你开了个很坏的玩笑……”

paras.en: And he laughed again.
paras.zh: 他又笑了起来。

paras.en: “It will be as though I had given you, instead of stars, lots of little bells that know how to laugh...”
paras.zh: “那就好像我送给你的不是星星，而是一大堆会笑的小铃铛……”

paras.en: And he laughed again. Then he grew serious again:
paras.zh: 他又笑了起来。随后，他又认真起来：

paras.en: “Tonight... you know... don't come.”
paras.zh: “今天夜里……你知道……别来。”

paras.en: “I won't leave you.”
paras.zh: “我不会离开你。”

paras.en: “I'll look as though I'm in pain... I'll look a little as though I'm dying. That's how it is. Don't come and watch that. There's no need...”
paras.zh: “我看起来会像是在疼……会有一点像是快要死了。就是这样。别来看这些，没有必要……”

paras.en: “I won't leave you.”
paras.zh: “我不会离开你。”

paras.en: But he was worried.
paras.zh: 可是他心里很担忧。

paras.en: “I’m telling you this… it’s also because of the snake. It mustn’t bite you… Snakes are nasty. They can bite just for fun…”
paras.zh: “我跟你说这些……也是因为那条蛇。不能让它咬你……蛇很坏。它们会咬人，只是为了好玩……”

paras.en: “I won’t leave you.”
paras.zh: “我不会离开你。”

paras.en: But something reassured him:
paras.zh: 不过，有件事让他安心了些：

paras.en: “It’s true they have no venom left for a second bite…”
paras.zh: “不过，蛇咬第二口时，确实就没有毒液了……”

paras.en: That night I did not see him set off. He had slipped away without a sound. When I managed to catch up with him, he was walking quickly and determinedly. All he said to me was:
paras.zh: 那天夜里，我没有看见他动身。他悄无声息地溜走了。等我终于追上他时，他正快步走着，脚步坚定。他只对我说了一句：

paras.en: “Ah! You’re here…”
paras.zh: “啊！你在这儿……”

paras.en: And he took my hand. But he began to worry again:
paras.zh: 他拉住了我的手。可是他又担忧起来：

paras.en: “You shouldn’t have come. You’ll be sad. I’ll look as though I’m dead, but it won’t be true…”
paras.zh: “你不该来的。你会难过的。到时候，我看起来会像死了一样，可那不是真的……”

paras.en: I stayed silent.
paras.zh: 我默不作声。

paras.en: “You understand. It’s too far. I can’t take this body with me. It’s too heavy.”
paras.zh: “你明白的。太远了。我没法带着这副身体走。它太重了。”

paras.en: I stayed silent.
paras.zh: 我默不作声。

paras.en: “But it will be like an old piece of bark left behind. There is nothing sad about old pieces of bark...”
paras.zh: “可那就像一块被丢下的老树皮。老树皮并不让人难过……”

paras.en: I stayed silent.
paras.zh: 我默不作声。

paras.en: He grew a little discouraged. But he tried once more:
paras.zh: 他有些泄气了。但他还是又努力了一次：

paras.en: “It will be nice, you know. I will look at the stars too. All the stars will be wells, each with a rusty pulley. All the stars will pour me something to drink...”
paras.zh: “你知道，那会很美好的。我也会看星星。所有的星星都会变成水井，每口井都有一个生锈的滑轮。所有的星星都会倒水给我喝……”

paras.en: I stayed silent.
paras.zh: 我默不作声。

paras.en: “It will be such fun! You will have five hundred million little bells, and I will have five hundred million fountains...”
paras.zh: “那会多么有趣啊！你会有五亿个小铃铛，我会有五亿眼泉水……”

paras.en: And he too fell silent, because he was crying...
paras.zh: 他也不说话了，因为他在哭……

paras.en: “This is the place. Let me take one step all by myself.”
paras.zh: “就是这里。让我独自走一步吧。”

paras.en: And he sat down because he was afraid.
paras.zh: 他坐了下来，因为他害怕。

paras.en: He spoke again:
paras.zh: 他又说：

paras.en: “You know... my flower... I’m responsible for her! And she is so weak! And she is so naïve. She has four little thorns, next to nothing, to protect her against the world...”
paras.zh: “你知道……我的花……我要对她负责！而她那么柔弱！而她那么天真。她只有四根微不足道的刺，护着她抵挡整个世界……”

paras.en: I sat down because I could no longer stay on my feet. He said:
paras.zh: 我坐了下来，因为我再也站不住了。他说：

paras.en: “There... That’s all...”
paras.zh: “好了……就是这些……”

paras.en: He hesitated a little longer, then stood up again. He took one step. I could not move.
paras.zh: 他又犹豫了一会儿，然后重新站起来。他迈了一步。我却动弹不得。

paras.en: There was only a yellow flash near his ankle. He stayed still for a moment. He did not cry out. He fell gently, as a tree falls. It did not even make a sound, because of the sand.
paras.zh: 只有一道黄光在他脚踝旁闪过。他一动不动地停了片刻。他没有叫喊。他轻轻倒下，像一棵树倒下那样。因为有沙子，连一点声音也没有。
